steps.title: Three steps to drops
steps.asideText: Everything you need to start receiving gifts without the friction

step1.title: Create your account
step1.text: Sign up in under a minute. Claim your unique name and make the space yours.

step2.title: Add your wishes
step2.text: Create lots: add a photo, title, price, and link to the item. Dream big — from a cup of coffee to a brand-new microphone.

step3.title: Share with your fans
step3.text: Copy your link and drop it in your bio, stories, or video description. Fans visit your storefront and gift you exactly what you want.
